title: An idea I'm testing in Flatiron, NoMad and Union Square
s1: {BRAND_NAME} is an idea I'm testing: bring sealed snacks and drinks from emerging brands to a handful of offices around Flatiron, NoMad and Union Square, about once a month.
s2: SAMPLE The office gets it free. It costs nothing.
s3: The brand would pay a fixed fee per office and get a one-page report that keeps every count separate: units delivered, placed and gone, survey answers, QR scans and code redemptions.
s4: No personal data about employees would be collected, and the survey would be anonymous.
s5: SAMPLE Book your founding spot now at a special price.
